title: West of the Champions' Guild
clueimage: Clue scroll (easy) - West of the Champions' Guild map.png
image: Clue scroll (easy) - West of the Champions' Guild.png
solution: South-west of Varrock, west of the Champions' Guild, and south-west of the Varrock south-west mine.
travel: Varrock lodestone, then run west

title: South-east Varrock mine
clueimage: Clue scroll (easy) - South-east Varrock mine map.png
solution: South of Varrock, near the Varrock south-east mine.
location: North of the Varrock south-east mine
travel:
* Nature's sentinel outfit to elder tree south of Varrock, then run east.
* Varrock lodestone, then run east.

title: Falador standing stones
clueimage: Clue scroll (easy) - Falador standing stones map.png
solution: North of Falador's Party Room on the other side of the wall to the east of Gamers' Grotto inside the standing stones. Dig in between one of the large stones and the tree on the east side.
travel:
* Elder divination outfit to flickering wisps, then run east.
* Skull sceptre to Barbarian Village (1), then run south-west.
* Falador lodestone, then run east.

title: Brother Galahad's house
clueimage: Clue scroll (easy) - Brother Galahad's house map.png
solution: Brother Galahad's house. Across the river from the coal trucks, west of Seers' Village. Follow the coal truck tracks all the way to the bridge.
travel:
* Combat bracelet to Ranging Guild, then run north-west.
* Seers' Village lodestone, then run west.

title: Wizards' Tower
solution: Just south of the Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village. Dig just east of the large rock. One pace south-east of the location pictured.
travel:
* Fairy ring code 
* Wicked hood teleport to the Wizards' Tower (right click 'Teleport' option, not 'Activate' option)
* Amulet of glory teleport to Draynor Village
* Draynor lodestone

title: Yanille anvils
solution: South of Yanille bank. Behind the house with an anvil. It is right next to the dead tree mentioning Mod Timbo in its examine message. You can dig inside of the building next to the tree.
travel:
* Yanille lodestone, then run east.
* Watchtower Teleport to Yanille, then run east.
* Teleport to house (if player-owned house is in Yanille) or Yanille tablet, then run east.

title: Hobgoblin Peninsula
solution: Hobgoblin Peninsula, west of the Crafting Guild; dig next to the 2nd spawn of snape grass, counting from the end of the peninsula. If your combat level is under level 70, watch out for the level 30/35 hobgoblins. One pace south of the location pictured.
travel:
* Skills necklace to the Crafting Guild, then run west.
* Modified artisan's bandana to the Crafting Guild, then run west.
* Port Sarim lodestone, then run north-west.

title: McGrubor's Wood
solution: Inside McGrubor's Wood, west of Seers' Village. If approaching from outside, squeeze through the broken fence by the northern half of the hut in the centre and search the crate south of the house. Watch out for Guard dogs.
travel:
* Fairy ring code 
* Seers' Village lodestone

title: Tower of Life
clueimage: Clue scroll (medium) - Tower of Life map.png
solution: Just south of East Ardougne, north of the Tower of Life, near the Necromancer's tower. Dig three spaces north of the western crate that Bonafido is leaning on. Look for the construction worker usually counting in the mid thousands. One pace east of the location pictured.
location: North of the Tower of Life
travel:
* Kandarin monastery Teleport and run east.
* Fairy ring code.

title: Clock Tower
solution: Stacked behind the Clock tower building south of Ardougne Castle.
travel:
* Spirit tree teleport to the Battlefield (3)
* Use the Kandarin monastery Teleport teleport to the Ardougne Monastery then run north-west

title: Observatory
solution: North-east of the Observatory, north of Castle Wars, south of Ourania Runecrafting Altar. There are three buildings that have been destroyed by goblins; search the crate in the western-most building.
travel:
* 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport or Dave's spellbook with a 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport charge, then run east.
* Ring of duelling to Castle Wars, cross the bridge (east), run north, cross the bridge (west), then run north-east
* Yanille lodestone, then run north-west, cross the bridge (west), then run north-east

clueimage: Clue scroll (hard) - Dark Warriors' Fortress map.png
solution:
In level 14 Wilderness, at the Dark Warriors' Fortress, search the pile of crates in the south-west corner of the central courtyard.
This area is a hotspot for player killers. As the location is in the Wilderness, being opted out of PVP is recommended.
The guards are aggressive and can interrupt your reward interface; it is recommended to open caskets at a safe location so as to not lose the opportunity to reroll rewards.
travel:
* Wilderness sword 2 (or higher) teleport to Forinthry Dungeon, exit, then run west.
* Teleport to chaos altar, exit, then run north-west.

title: West Ardougne
solution: Located inside the city walls of West Ardougne. Enter the main gate and head west past the water pumps to the graveyard. West of the graveyard are 4 rows of long buildings, orientated north to south, in various stages of disrepair. Go to the easternmost long building of the four long buildings and into the northernmost room. Dig inside the room in the north-west corner.
travel:
* 'Chipped' Ardougne teleport (or Dave's spellbook), then run west.
* Lever.
* Ardougne lodestone, then run southwest.
* Ardougne Teleport
* Skills necklace to the Fishing Guild, then run south, then west.

title: Chemist's house
solution: Just west of the chemist's house in Rimmington. South of Falador, west of Port Sarim. The exact spot of the clue is inaccessible, but any tile adjacent to the spot works.
travel:
* House Teleport (if player-owned house is in Rimmington)
* Rimmington tablet, then run south-west.

title: Falador statue crossroads
clueimage: Clue scroll (easy) - Falador statue crossroads map.png
solution: Just north of Falador, at the crossroads where there is a statue.
travel: Falador lodestone, then run north.

title: Wilderness small volcanoes
clueimage: Clue scroll (hard) - Wilderness small volcanoes map.png
solution: Level 50 Wilderness, near the Wilderness Agility Course; south-west of Deep Wilderness Dungeon entrance and west of the Mage Arena; dig between the three small volcanoes. As the location is in Wilderness, being opted out of player killing is recommended.
travel:
* Wilderness sword 4 teleport to Wilderness Agility Course, then run east.
* Wilderness obelisk (level 44 Wilderness), then run north-east.
* Ghorrock Teleport or Ice Plateau Teleport, then run east.

title: Legends' Guild
solution: South of the Legends' Guild, north-east of East Ardougne, next to the benches near the Legends' Guild south-west mine.
travel:
* Cape of legends teleport option to outside of Legends' Guild.
* Fairy ring code, then run south-west.
* Quest Cape teleport option to Legends' Guild (7), exit guild and run south-west a few paces.
* Ardougne lodestone, then run east.
* Ardougne Teleport, then run north-east.

title: Miscellania
solution: On Miscellania, one of the Fremennik Isles, just east of the castle.
travel:
* Miscellania Teleport
* Fairy ring code

title: Mort Myre Swamp
clueimage: Clue scroll (medium) - Mort Myre Swamp map.png
solution: North of the Abandoned Mine, by the path to Mort'ton. One pace south-east of the location pictured.
travel:
* Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to Burgh de Rott, then run north to Mort'ton and then south-west. Alternatively, run west to the agility shortcut, then north of the Abandoned Mine.
* Gate (Mort Myre Swamp) to the Nature Grotto, then run south.

title: Ourania Cave entrance
clueimage: Clue scroll (medium) - Ourania Cave entrance map.png
solution: The Chaos altar north of the Observatory, the entrance to the Ourania Runecrafting Altar. Stand and dig left next to the standards (flags) behind the altar.
travel:
* Ourania Teleport
* 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport (or Dave's spellbook), then run north.
* Spirit tree to the Battlefield, then run south-west.

title: Between Seers' Village and Rellekka
clueimage: Clue scroll (medium) - Between Seers' Village and Rellekka map.png
image: Clue scroll (medium) - Between Seers' Village and Rellekka.png
solution: On the road between Seers' Village and Rellekka. The two trees indicated on the map are oak trees, just south of the Musician. Dig in the spot indicated, just on top of the fern. One pace east of the location pictured.
travel:
* Seers' Village lodestone and run north
* Fairy ring code.

title: Lighthouse peninsula
solution: Road between Rellekka and the Lighthouse. One pace west of the location pictured.
location: Road between Rellekka and the Lighthouse
travel:
* Nature's sentinel outfit teleport to the active crystal tree (providing the nearby tree is the active one).
* Lighthouse Teleport scroll.
* Rellekka tablet (modified POH teleport tablet).
* Enchanted lyre teleport to Rellekka.
* Fremennik Province lodestone.
* Games necklace teleport to Barbarian Assault.

title: Draynor Village
solution: South of Draynor Village bank, by the fishing spot, slightly north of the small obelisk.
travel: Amulet of glory to Draynor Village.

title: Fort Forinthry
solution: South of Fort Forinthry's walls, inside a crate. The crate is not featured on the map, but can be searched for the next sealed clue scroll or reward casket.
travel:
* Fort Forinthry lodestone or Fort Forinthry Teleport scroll
* Wicked hood or earth altar teleport tablet to the earth altar, then run north
* Dig Site pendant to the Dig Site, then run north-west
* Archaeology journal to the Archaeology Guild, then run north-west
* Balloon transport system to Varrock, then run north.
